arxiv-2101-02708.title: Revisiting the role of grooming in DIS
arxiv-2101-02708.creator: Y. Makris
arxiv-2101-02708.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Y. Makris. We introduce a novel grooming procedure, which is an extension of the modified MassDrop tagging algorithm, tailored to the needs of deep inelastic scattering (DIS). The new algorithm, which grooms the event as a whole, takes advantage of the natural separation of current and target fragmentation in the Breit frame, in order to eliminate radiation in the beam and central rapidity regions.

arxiv-2211-04272.title: Rank-expanding satellite operators on the topological knot concordance group
arxiv-2211-04272.creator: Charles Livingston
arxiv-2211-04272.description: Abstract . Given a fixed knot P ⊂ S 1 × B 2 P\subset S^{1}\times B^{2} and any knot K ⊂ S 3 K\subset S^{3} , one can form the satellite of K K with pattern P P . This operation induces a self-map of the concordance group of knots in S 3 S^{3} .

arxiv-2402-03301.title: Two-loop amplitudes for t ​ t ¯ ​ H t\bar{t}H production: the quark-initiated N f N_{f} -part Preprint: IPPP/24/03, KA-TP-02-2024, P3H-24-007, TTK-24-03
arxiv-2402-03301.creator: Bakul Agarwal, Gudrun Heinrich, Stephen P. Jones, Matthias Kerner, Sven Yannick Klein, Jannis Lang, Vitaly Magerya, Anton Olsson
arxiv-2402-03301.description: Abstract We present numerical results for the two-loop virtual amplitude entering the NNLO corrections to Higgs boson production in association with a top quark pair at the LHC, focusing, as a proof of concept of our method, on the part of the quark-initiated channel containing loops of massless or massive quarks.

arxiv-2410-21775.title: Inherent circular dichroism of phonons in magnetic Weyl semimetal Co 3 Sn 2 S 2
arxiv-2410-21775.creator: R. Yang, Y.-Y. Zhu, M. Steigleder, X.-G. Qiu, T. -T. Zhang, M. Dressel
arxiv-2410-21775.description: Abstract We investigated the infrared-active phonons in ferromagnetic Weyl semimetal Co 3 Sn 2 S 2 using optical spectroscopy. Below the Curie temperature ( T C ≈ 175 T_{C}\approx 175 K), we observed asymmetric Fano lineshapes of phonons peaks in the optical conductivities, reflecting the presence of electron-phonon coupling (EPC).

arxiv-2411-13058.title: Detectability of lensed gravitational waves in matched-filtering searches
arxiv-2411-13058.creator: Juno C. L. Chan, Eungwang Seo, Alvin K. Y. Li, Heather Fong, Jose M. Ezquiaga
arxiv-2411-13058.description: Abstract Gravitational lensing by compact, small-scale intervening masses causes frequency-dependent distortions to gravitational-wave events. The optimal signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) is often used as a proxy for the detectability of exotic signals in gravitational-wave searches. In reality, the detectability of such signals in a matched-filtering search requires comprehensive consideration of match-filtered SNR, signal-consistency test value, and other factors.

arxiv-2506-17565.title: Transient star B/R ratio and star formation in z ≳ 1 z\gtrsim 1 lensed galaxies
arxiv-2506-17565.creator: Sung Kei Li, Jose M. Palencia, Jose M. Diego, Jeremy Lim, Patrick L. Kelly, Ashish K. Meena, James Nianias, Hayley Williams, Liliya L.R. Williams, Adi Zitrin
arxiv-2506-17565.description: Abstract The extreme magnification from galaxy clusters and microlenses therein allows the detection of individual, luminous stars in lensed galaxies as transient events, and hence provides a valuable window into the high mass stellar population in z > 1 z>1 galaxies.

arxiv-2601-04356.title: UNIC: Learning Unified Multimodal Extrinsic Contact Estimation
arxiv-2601-04356.creator: Zhengtong Xu, Yuki Shirai
arxiv-2601-04356.description: Abstract Contact-rich manipulation requires reliable estimation of extrinsic contacts—the interactions between a grasped object and its environment—which provide essential contextual information for planning, control, and policy learning. However, existing approaches often rely on restrictive assumptions, such as predefined contact types, fixed grasp configurations, or camera calibration, that hinder generalization to novel objects and deployment in unstructured environments.

pmc-12967418.description: The free-swimming gelatinous stage of medusozoans, generally called ‘jellyfish’, frequently swarms around the intake area of the Fangchenggang Nuclear Power Plant, posing a noticeable risk to its operational safety. pmc-13322212.description: For many years, research on attention has been dominated by theories based on the assumption that attention is limited in capacity. pmc-13456355.title: Management of Treatment Resistant EGFR Inhibitor‐Induced Papulopustular Exanthema With Isotretinoin and Dapsone
pmc-13456355.creator: Ishana Dixit, Raquel Ruiz Araujo, Pablo Fernandez‐Peñas
pmc-13456355.description: Background/ObjectivesEpidermal growth factor receptor inhibitors (EGFRi) commonly cause papulopustular exanthemas that may compromise the success of cancer therapy. While tetracyclines are first‐line treatment, data on alternative systemic agents for refractory cases remain limited. This study compares the effectiveness and tolerability of isotretinoin and dapsone for managing tetracycline‐resistant EGFRi–induced papulopustular eruptions in a tertiary dermatology service.
